title: Mod Currencies
description: National currencies money is shown in (Content/currencies.json, or a scenario's currenciesFile). Display-only: the simulation keeps one money unit, the base currency, and amounts are converted when they are shown. Not part of the multiplayer lobby check.

era.description: Free-form label for the author; not read by the game.

baseCurrency.description: The unit the simulation counts in. Its symbol is shown to spectators, in menus, for countries without a currency, and when the player turns on the base-currency setting. A scenario's currencySymbol, when set, wins over this symbol.

symbolPosition.description: Whether the symbol leads the amount ("fl. 1.2K") or follows it ("45.0K ak.").

currencies.description: Later files replace a currency with the same id. A country listed under two currencies keeps the first.

symbolPosition.description: Whether the symbol leads the amount ("fl. 1.2K") or follows it ("45.0K ak.").

exchangeRateToBase.description: Local units per one base unit: at 45, an amount of 1,000 in the base currency is shown as 45.0K.

associatedCountries.description: ISO3 codes of the countries that use this currency.
